templates.job: Introduce the national brand, cover the full service range and route each customer quickly.
templates.variants: One national homepage. Service and location navigation do the detailed routing. A proof strip may appear early only when genuinely supported.
templates.evidence: Approved brand introduction; service taxonomy; coverage policy; price policy; approved proof records.
templates.links: All services, locations finder, pricing, About, selected cases and quote.
templates.technical: Unique broad title/meta; Organisation/WebSite identity where supported; do not invent branches or aggregates.
templates.mobile: Keep service choice and quote accessible early. Stack service groups; avoid a full-screen hero or long suburb carousel before useful content.
templates.acceptance: Can a visitor identify the brand, choose any service and begin a quote without scrolling through location names?
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift, local_verification, intent_capture_speed, entity_coherence, entity_reinforcement, pricing_transparency, obfuscated_pricing, eeat_experience, grounded_claims, information_gain

templates.job: Help visitors select the correct service without competing with full service pages.
templates.variants: Category groupings are sections first. Add a category URL only when it has a distinct useful role.
templates.evidence: Service ID, category, title, short scope, display order and canonical path.
templates.links: Each service, pricing, location finder, quote.
templates.technical: CollectionPage semantics where appropriate; crawlable cards; no identical child descriptions repeated at length.
templates.mobile: Use readable stacked service cards with a one-tap destination. Avoid horizontal category tabs that conceal services.
templates.acceptance: All services reachable; groups have plain labels; visitors can distinguish overlapping services.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift, grounded_claims, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, local_verification, intent_capture_speed, pricing_transparency, obfuscated_pricing, information_gain

templates.job: Convert customers seeking one defined service with sufficient scope and pricing detail.
templates.variants: All 12 services use one template with distinct service configuration. Approved subservices use a narrower version and link to the parent; synonyms do not create subservices.
templates.evidence: Service scope/version; material restrictions; cost rules; preparation; optional policy; proof links; keyword owner.
templates.links: Parent services hub, service pricing/checklist, guide hub, local service pages, quote.
templates.technical: Unique title/H1 and canonical; Service data only for actual visible offer; truthful provider reference.
templates.mobile: Expose scope and price qualifications before long proof galleries. Compact contents links may jump to inclusions, pricing and FAQs; keep quote available without covering content.
templates.acceptance: Could this page still describe another service after changing its title? If yes, rewrite the scope and evidence before release.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, information_gain, content_integrity, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, pricing_transparency, obfuscated_pricing, intent_capture_speed, eeat_experience, grounded_claims, local_verification, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Let visitors find their locality and available service path.
templates.variants: Map is optional. Current >2,000 population planning scenario controls published locality routes, not whether the company can serve customers elsewhere.
templates.evidence: Locality IDs, state, postcode associations, publication flags, region relationships, coverage messaging.
templates.links: All state hubs, crawlable directory pages, services and quote.
templates.technical: HTML directory available without map; avoid indexable search-result permutations.
templates.mobile: Make the finder the first practical control. Show locality/state/postcode choices as large tap targets; directory and pagination work without a map.
templates.acceptance: A rural customer and a same-name-suburb customer can find the right record; omitted page does not mean unserved area.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, local_verification, intent_capture_speed, geographic_authority, semantic_html, information_gain, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift

templates.job: Help customers in a state, region or locality select the right local service.
templates.variants: State, city/region and suburb variants share A05. State pages emphasise navigation; suburb pages emphasise local service choices and practical detail. One canonical locality page regardless of postcode count.
templates.evidence: Locality/region ID, name/state, postcodes, parent relationships, verified local considerations, eligible services, proof provenance.
templates.links: Parent state or region; service-location children; nearby localities only when useful; quote.
templates.technical: One canonical per entity; actual breadcrumbs; areaServed is coverage, not a fabricated address.
templates.mobile: Show service choices before long locality lists. Nearby links and geographic directory collapse by meaningful group; keep coverage qualifications visible.
templates.acceptance: Local content has a reason to exist beyond the name; reviews/photos match stated geography; missing local proof does not trigger fabrication.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift, city_modifier_legitimacy, local_verification, information_gain, geographic_authority, semantic_html, pricing_transparency, obfuscated_pricing, intent_capture_speed, eeat_experience, grounded_claims

templates.job: Answer one service need in one locality or region and convert it.
templates.variants: City and suburb are variants of A06, not extra templates. Bond/end-of-lease/vacate pages for the same location share intent unless research establishes a genuinely different service.
templates.evidence: Service ID + locality ID; approved scope; price applicability; genuine local context; evidence IDs; primary intent.
templates.links: Locality hub, national service, supporting guides/pricing/checklist and quote.
templates.technical: Unique canonical service-locality pair; no postcode duplicates; do not auto-publish content with only name substitutions.
templates.mobile: Keep service and locality visible in the introduction and quote context. Use concise local facts; price and exclusions must not disappear in accordions.
templates.acceptance: Can the editor state the useful local difference and its source? Is the service factual, the answer complete and the conversion path working?
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, information_gain, content_integrity, city_modifier_legitimacy, local_verification, pricing_transparency, obfuscated_pricing, intent_capture_speed, eeat_experience, grounded_claims, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Answer the cost question transparently and route an informed quote request.
templates.variants: National table summarises all services; dedicated service page provides genuine detail. Do not create location-specific pricing pages unless prices/intent materially differ.
templates.evidence: Price schedule/version, unit, scope, tax, range, assessment factors, validity, exclusions, approval owner.
templates.links: National pricing ↔ service pricing ↔ service page; checklist and quote.
templates.technical: No fabricated Offer values; avoid price schema until accurate and maintained. Summary and detailed page own different intent.
templates.mobile: Turn comparison rows into labelled cards on small screens or provide an explicitly labelled scroll region. Keep units, tax and assumptions with each price.
templates.acceptance: Price and conditions stay adjacent on mobile; any estimate matches calculator and backend; scope changes invalidate old figures.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, information_gain, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift, pricing_transparency, obfuscated_pricing, grounded_claims, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, intent_capture_speed, entity_reinforcement

templates.job: Provide a usable full scope reference and reduce quote uncertainty.
templates.variants: Recommended for house, end-of-lease and construction cleaning. Others remain conditional. Printable rendering is a view of the same record, not a new content type.
templates.evidence: Task IDs, group, status, condition, service scope version, effective date, policy link.
templates.links: Parent service and pricing, preparation guide, quote.
templates.technical: Accessible list/table; print and screen share source; avoid duplicate indexable print HTML.
templates.mobile: Use room/surface anchors and text status labels, not colour alone. Checkboxes are optional personal interaction, not changes to the booked scope.
templates.acceptance: Printed status labels survive without colour; exclusions are not hidden in collapsed content; no accidental cross-service inclusions.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, information_gain, semantic_html, intent_capture_speed, content_integrity, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, grounded_claims, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Organise useful evergreen advice by service and customer task.
templates.variants: National and per-service hubs share A09. Initial 24 guide directions are retained; not every guide needs identical sections.
templates.evidence: Guide ID, service taxonomy, task category, title, summary, reviewer/date and canonical path.
templates.links: Guide children, service parent, checklist, blog where useful.
templates.technical: Collection semantics; index only substantive collections; no empty tag archives.
templates.mobile: Stack guide cards and keep service/task filters short. Do not force a reader through a multi-level menu to reach preparation advice.
templates.acceptance: Every guide belongs to a clear service/task and can be reached without relying on JavaScript search.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift, intent_capture_speed, information_gain, semantic_html, entity_reinforcement

templates.job: Answer an evergreen practical task fully and responsibly.
templates.variants: Preparation, aftercare and comparison variants reuse A10. No arbitrary length or required FAQ count. For end-of-lease, aftercare concerns inspection/handover.
templates.evidence: Task intent, prerequisites, material limits, author/reviewer, sources, evidence assets and service link.
templates.links: Guide hub, parent service, checklist and selected related guide.
templates.technical: Article data with real author/date; text instructions accessible; do not promise HowTo or FAQ rich results.
templates.mobile: Readable article width, optional compact contents, labelled diagrams and tables with accessible alternatives; no sticky quote control covering instructions.
templates.acceptance: Does it answer the task without a sales detour? Are unsafe material/product claims checked and limits visible?
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, information_gain, eeat_experience, content_integrity, semantic_html, intent_capture_speed, helpful_content, grounded_claims, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Help readers discover focused editorial questions across all services.
templates.variants: Filtered categories remain views by default; do not generate twelve empty SEO category pages. Curated category pages need their own useful role.
templates.evidence: Article ID, service/category, summary, date, author, image rights and status.
templates.links: Articles, guides and services.
templates.technical: Blog/CollectionPage semantics where useful; canonical/filter policy; real dates only.
templates.mobile: Use a clear filter toggle, selected filter chips and visible reset. Preserve scroll position when returning from an article.
templates.acceptance: All articles are discoverable; filters remain usable on a phone; empty states guide recovery.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, intent_capture_speed, information_gain, semantic_html, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Resolve a narrower customer question or explain a relevant situation.
templates.variants: The 50 existing topic proposals remain briefs, not completed articles or measured long-tail keywords. Merge overlapping article/guide intent before writing.
templates.evidence: Question intent, primary service, editorial body, author/reviewer, evidence and canonical owner.
templates.links: Blog index, commercial service, relevant guide and case if cited.
templates.technical: BlogPosting/Article based on actual record; no fake freshness or author credentials.
templates.mobile: Lead with the answer and readable byline; use inline context links. Avoid intrusive lead popups or automatic galleries.
templates.acceptance: Article adds a useful answer beyond parent service/guide; no repeated sales filler or automatic city versions.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, eeat_experience, content_integrity, information_gain, helpful_content, grounded_claims, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization, intent_capture_speed

templates.job: Help prospects inspect genuine examples relevant to their job.
templates.variants: No fabricated sample jobs at launch. If none are approved, hold the public index until it is useful rather than displaying empty proof.
templates.evidence: Case IDs, service/locality relationships, captions, permission, summary and publication state.
templates.links: Case detail, service and reviews.
templates.technical: Collection semantics; filters do not automatically create indexable URLs.
templates.mobile: Service filter first; image cards keep captions and outcomes visible. Provide a clear empty-result reset.
templates.acceptance: Filtering never attributes a case to a service/location it does not represent.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, intent_capture_speed, information_gain, semantic_html, grounded_claims, content_integrity, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Demonstrate actual work, scope and bounded outcomes.
templates.variants: Service choice controls fields: carpet material/stain, end-of-lease agreed inspection scope, exterior surface/access, etc. Images may be absent; auditable job evidence may not.
templates.evidence: Case model from architecture: service/locality IDs, approved scope, process, outcome, limitations, assets, consent, job source and dates.
templates.links: Case index, service, genuine locality/service page and quote.
templates.technical: Article/CreativeWork semantics where appropriate; protect customer identity; avoid fake Person/LocalBusiness facts.
templates.mobile: Stack problem, scope and outcome in that order. Before/after images remain separately viewable and labelled, not dependent on a drag slider.
templates.acceptance: Every measurable result is supported; image pair represents the same job; failed/partial outcomes are not concealed.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, eeat_experience, local_verification, information_gain, grounded_claims, content_integrity, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization, intent_capture_speed

templates.job: Let visitors assess attributable customer experience by service and location.
templates.variants: One main page; no public URL per short review by default. Empty filters explain no matching records rather than implying no service coverage.
templates.evidence: Review/source IDs, original URL/date, permitted text/name, rating scale, service/location evidence and deduplication status.
templates.links: Original sources, cases, services and contact.
templates.technical: No promised self-serving business review stars; do not add unsupported AggregateRating markup.
templates.mobile: Reviews remain readable without forced carousels. Show source/date with the text; expose a clear expand action for long reviews.
templates.acceptance: Original meaning preserved, sources reachable and no misattributed geography or edited sentiment.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, grounded_claims, content_integrity, intent_capture_speed, semantic_html, information_gain, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Explain the business or an approved partnership proposition with clear accountability.
templates.variants: Partner with Us retains the brand shell but needs its own proposition and enquiry type. Do not promise a franchise or employment arrangement.
templates.evidence: Business facts, approved partnership types/terms, evidence, accountable contact and enquiry routing.
templates.links: Services, cases, reviews, contact and relevant enquiry route.
templates.technical: AboutPage semantics for About; Organisation facts shared centrally; partner affiliations need approval.
templates.mobile: Partner eligibility and enquiry label appear early. The partnership enquiry must not look like a residential price calculator.
templates.acceptance: Can readers distinguish customer cleaning quotes from partnership enquiries and understand what happens next?
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, entity_coherence, entity_reinforcement, grounded_claims, eeat_experience, intent_capture_speed, information_gain

templates.job: Collect the right information once, preserve context and confirm enquiry receipt.
templates.variants: Direct empty entry, service-prefilled, location-prefilled, estimator handoff and partnership enquiry variant. Success is a state, not a new indexed landing page.
templates.evidence: Opaque draft ID; service/locality IDs; estimate version and assumptions; source attribution; answers; consent versions; submission status. Final field inventory remains pending.
templates.links: Relevant service/price/checklist, privacy, terms and contact; avoid taking users out of an incomplete form unnecessarily.
templates.technical: Public quote URL has its own canonical; private draft/session/success URLs excluded from indexing and sitemaps; no PII in URL or analytics events.
templates.mobile: 16 px minimum input text, 48 px preferred controls, appropriate keyboards, visible labels and focus-to-error. Suppress overlapping sticky bars while editing. Summary can collapse but essential estimate conditions stay visible.
templates.acceptance: Test direct entry, prefill, back/refresh, edits/recalculation, expired draft, failed request and duplicate click; success only after lead system acceptance.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, intent_capture_speed, grounded_claims

templates.job: Resolve an enquiry or concern with accurate steps and policy.
templates.variants: Contact is lean; FAQ is grouped Q&A; rectification is policy plus reporting path. Same layout system, explicitly different required content.
templates.evidence: Enquiry type, contact details, policy/eligibility version, FAQ owners, response process, secure report routing.
templates.links: Services, checklist, conditions, quote for new work only.
templates.technical: ContactPage semantics where suitable; useful visible FAQs without rich-result promises. General contact exempt from requested score target.
templates.mobile: Put the relevant contact/report action before supporting detail. Support form recovery must retain entries; eligibility and deadline information stay visible.
templates.acceptance: No lost support report, no forced new booking, and conditions match the agreed policy across landing pages.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, information_gain, verification_of_pricing_and_policy, grounded_claims, intent_capture_speed, entity_reinforcement, keyword_cannibalization

templates.job: Provide readable controlled policy information or navigation.
templates.variants: Privacy, terms and accessibility use document variant; sitemap uses directory variant. No sales FAQ, reviews or sticky quote bar in the reading flow.
templates.evidence: Policy content/version, owner, dates, contact; sitemap canonical route records.
templates.links: Relevant policies and contact; sitemap links public canonical pages only.
templates.technical: Semantic headings; correct canonical/index policy; no FAQ/Review schema fabrication. Privacy and terms exempt from content score target.
templates.mobile: Readable long text, contents anchors and no intrusive sales bar. Sitemap groups expand accessibly and still expose crawlable links.
templates.acceptance: Policy version matches form consent links; long content readable at zoom; sitemap excludes private/404/draft paths.
templates.labels: explicit_intent, direct_match, semantic_html, intent_capture_speed, content_integrity, grounded_claims

templates.job: Help a visitor recover from a missing URL.
templates.variants: The layout is a reusable error state, not thousands of separate SEO pages. No heavy sales sections or reviews.
templates.evidence: Requested path handled safely, known published route suggestions and error telemetry without personal data.
templates.links: Home, services, locations and contact.
templates.technical: Return actual 404; omit from sitemap; never serve a soft-404 200 page or redirect every missing URL to home.
templates.mobile: Short explanation and a few large recovery links; do not recreate a full landing page or obscure the missing-page message.
templates.acceptance: Keyboard-accessible recovery and correct HTTP response; no broken links among suggestions.
templates.labels: direct_match, local_verification, intent_capture_speed, keyword_cannibalization, service_dilution_drift, explicit_intent
